_readme: Transcription of docs/Allianz Member Satisfaction Survey_Scripting_Final.pdf.
This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR WORDING and nothing else: no slot names, no
conditions, no policy. Those live in slot_map.json, and scripts/compile_script.py
Every 'text' here is the document's wording verbatim, and
tests/test_script_sources.py reads the PDF's own text layer and fails if any of
it has drifted. Whitespace is collapsed before comparison; nothing else is.
role:  agent     spoken by the agent
document  printed in the script but never spoken (routing rules, key)
node ids are stable identifiers for the transcribed turns. They appear in the
call outcome's visited_nodes, so renaming one is a breaking change.

source.title: Allianz Member Satisfaction Survey (MSAT)
source.program: Sagility Smart Step program offered by Allianz Life Insurance company

turns.text: Hello, this is the Sagility Smart Step Program offered by Allianz Life Insurance company . We are calling everyone who participated in the Smart Step program and would like to hear your feedback. Please call us back at 1-888-855-7837 between 8am and 8pm Eastern Time. You may also go online to take the survey at allianz.sagilitysmartsteps.com. That's a-l-l-i-a-n-z dot s-a-g-i-l-i-t-y-s-m-a-r-t-s-t-e-p-s dot com. Thank you.
Hello, this is Ida, your virtual assistant from the Sagility Smart Step program offered by Allianz Life Insurance company. May I speak to [policyholder's full name]?

Thank you for taking my call. We're calling everyone who participated in the Smart Step program to get your feedback and make the program even better. Do you have a couple of minutes for me to ask you a few questions?
Would you like to reschedule the call for a better time?
Please hold on and I will get you to someone to reschedule.
Thank you for your time.
Great. Let's get started. Please tell us about your experiences with the Smart Step Aging in Place service by completing a short satisfaction survey.
Were you able to review any of the program resources such as action plans, articles, videos, or websites?
How helpful were the resources, articles, or websites in making at least one lifestyle change while participating in the program?
How helpful were the resources, articles, or websites in making at least one lifestyle change while participating in the program?
options: No time to review the resources
Not interested in the available resources
Program website (Smart Step portal) was not working
source_note: The document prints question 1b with question 1a's stem, but 1b's four answer
options are reasons for NOT reviewing the resources. A helpfulness question
cannot be answered with 'No time to review the resources', so the printed stem
is a copy-paste from 1a rather than the question the branch means.
The verbatim text is kept here for audit. The spoken question comes from the
goal in slot_map.json, which asks for the reason. Asking the printed stem
would record a helpfulness rating from a member who just said they never
This needs a decision from the business, and is the one place where the agent
deliberately does not say what the document prints.

turns.text: We value your feedback. What changes or additions would you like to see to improve the program? If you do not have feedback, you can answer no or none.
Please tell us what you liked most about the program. If you do not have feedback, you can answer no or none.
Based on your experience with the Smart Step Aging in Place Program offered by Allianz, would you recommend our program to people you know?
If policyholder is high risk, ask question 5. If policyholder is rising risk skip to question 6.
Were program staff helpful and knowledgeable about the program and in guiding you through your action plan?
How would you rate your experience with the program overall?
This is the end of the survey. Thank you very much for your time and assistance. We appreciate the information and feedback you have provided us about the Smart Step program. Goodbye.
